entries.asBuilt: docs/02_TECHNICAL_CONTEXT.md §3.1 gates POST /api/hub/content on the requester's legacy trust tier being certified_professional or trusted_partner
entries.targetState: Publishing is gated ONLY by creatorGates().canUpload, which is derived from subscriptionPaid (paid Basic/Pro tier) — never from verification tier/trust score. KYC gates earning payout, not uploading. Verification badges are a fully separate credibility ladder.
entries.reason: docs/01_SPEC.md §6 and CLAUDE.md both explicitly state the trust-tier creator gate is the OLD, WRONG model, replaced by the two-independent-gates model. The actual current frontend (src/app/(focused)/create/**, wired in a prior fix wave) already implements the two-gate model exclusively — creatorGates().canUpload checks subscriptionPaid only, with zero verification/trust-tier logic anywhere in the upload path. docs/02_TECHNICAL_CONTEXT.md is a partially-stale doc per its own file-path staleness (already flagged as doc-internal-conflict in product-truths.json T- entries) — this is a second instance of the same staleness, not a new decision.

entries.asBuilt: docs/02_TECHNICAL_CONTEXT.md's endpoint sketches use a generic {statusCode, message, data} shape implicitly (e.g. { data: { purchased: true, fullAssetUrl } })
entries.targetState: Canonical envelope for every endpoint: {statusCode, message, data} for single responses; {statusCode, message, data: [], pagination: {currentPage, nextPage, perPage, total}} for paginated lists. This matches the sibling WAWU-ID and legacy WAWUAfrica-API services' existing convention (WAWUAfrica_API_Contracts.md), confirmed via direct inspection of /workspace/projects/WAWU-ID and /workspace/projects/WAWUAfrica-API.
entries.reason: Consistency with the live WAWU product family (sibling evidence) rather than inventing a new envelope shape for one more service in the same ecosystem.

entries.asBuilt: auth-flows fragment shows 5 SEAM-tagged actions (signUp, verifyOtp, signIn, requestPasswordReset, saveNewPassword) implying this new backend owns /api/hub/auth/* signup/login/OTP/password-reset
entries.targetState: This backend NEVER implements signup/login/OTP/password-reset. WAWU ID (external service) owns 100% of that -- frontend calls WAWU ID directly (POST /auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/otp/start+verify, /auth/forgot-password+reset-password on WAWU ID's own base URL), gets back a WAWU-ID-issued JWT, and this backend only ever verifies that JWT via JWKS. This backend's own 'signUp' endpoint (if any) is limited to WAWUAfrica-specific onboarding fields WAWU ID doesn't own: accountType (user|creator) and interests[] -- both saved via PATCH /api/hub/users/me AFTER the WAWU ID signup completes, not as part of a combined signup call.
entries.reason: Confirmed directly: (1) design/screens/WAWU Auth.dc.html's own line 35 states 'Auth stays with WAWU ID -- these screens collect and hand off, they do not replace it.' (2) Direct inspection of /workspace/projects/WAWU-ID confirms it's a real, live, separately-deployed service implementing exactly this surface today (POST /auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/otp/start+verify, /auth/forgot-password+reset-password, /auth/refresh, RS256 JWT). (3) conventions.md already commits to this architecture based on that recon. The frontend's SEAM comments predate the WAWU-ID-integration understanding and are the stale artifact here, not a real target contract.

entries.asBuilt: marketplace fragment shows this backend owning Shop/MarketplaceItem/MarketplaceProduct catalog data via /api/hub/marketplace/* endpoints
entries.targetState: This backend does NOT own the WAWUBasket/WAWUBeauty product catalog -- CLAUDE.md's non-negotiable rule is 'never rebuild their commerce engine.' Real target: the frontend integrates directly with the existing sibling WAWUBasket-API (and a Beauty equivalent) for product browsing/search, OR (deferred, out of scope for this build) this backend offers a thin read-only proxy later. For THIS build: /api/hub/marketplace/* is limited to what this backend legitimately owns -- MarketplaceSave (a WAWU-side bookmark referencing an external productId by string, no product data duplicated). Shop/MarketplaceItem/MarketplaceProduct reads stay on frontend mocks for this pass, clearly SEAM-tagged as 'external, not this backend.'
entries.reason: Direct product-rule conflict with CLAUDE.md non-negotiables. /workspace/projects/WAWUBasket-API exists as a real sibling service confirming the correct integration target, but wiring to it is a distinct integration effort not requested this session (user named Flutterwave and WAWU ID specifically) -- deferring rather than silently building a duplicate commerce backend.
